title: Synthetic data curation at group granularity

items: Effective Synthetic Data Curation Requires Group-Level Signals
Cathy Jiao and Chenyan Xiong, arXiv v1, September 30, 2026
Technical reading for AI data infrastructure engineering

note: 核心问题：单条样本分数的求和能否代表整组训练价值？本文用受控实验说明二者可能偏离。

title: The unit of selection changes the objective

items: Individual influence estimates a sample’s utility in isolation.
A group changes the model through multiple interacting optimization steps.
Synthetic paraphrases share origins and may concentrate training signal despite high individual scores.

note: 作者研究训练价值的非加性。不要把 group 简化成按来源分桶后的平均质量分。

title: Proxy oracle and group oracle

items: The proxy aggregates individual sample effects around the reference model.
The group oracle evaluates the validation-loss change after training on the group.
Matching proxy scores while varying composition isolates interactions that the additive proxy misses.

note: Oracle 是昂贵的实验参照，不是可直接用于全量生产的免费标签。参见第 2 节与附录 B.1。

title: Controlled group construction

items: BGE embeddings and k-means partition each corpus into 20 semantic clusters.
Groups span one to 20 clusters while their average individual proxy scores remain matched.
Gumbel-Top-k sampling selects groups under matched training budgets.

note: 既控制平均单样本效用，又改变语义与主题组成，避免仅用更高质量数据解释结果。第 3.2 节。

title: Training settings and controls
note: 这里只覆盖 400M/1.5B 文本实验，不是多模态或前沿规模的直接证据。第 3 节。

title: Synthetic recycling increases redundancy pressure

items: The pool contains 716,800 sequences for every rephrase factor.
Rephrase factors 1, 10, and 50 reduce unique source documents as repetitions rise.
FineWeb-Edu, BM25, and GradSim represent individual scoring. GMRel and GREATS include relations.

note: r=50 是高合成度压力测试。固定序列总数使来源覆盖度的变化更容易解释。第 4 节。

title: Reported average accuracy at r = 10
note: 表 9 的 8 项任务平均值，200 步 Repro-400M continuation。不同任务表现差异很大，平均分不能替代生成能力分项。

title: Gradient diversity targets expensive audits

items: Within-group gradient diversity predicts the proxy–oracle gap.
Reported Spearman correlations range from 0.58 to 0.63 across tested settings.
Audit high-diversity groups with the group oracle and use a cheaper proxy elsewhere.

note: 这是预算分配诊断，不是梯度越多样训练价值就一定越高。高 gap 意味着需要更准确估计。第 5 节。

title: Limits of the evidence

items: The oracle depends on the chosen validation objective and training horizon.
Groups are deliberately constructed. Real production mixtures may have different interactions.
Gradient extraction adds compute and memory overhead even when subsampling helps.

note: 作者结果支持关系信号值得保留，但不能推出任何 diversity 策略都能提升任意训练任务。

title: Curation data model implications

items: Inference: preserve synthetic parent IDs and generator versions alongside each record.
Inference: materialize group membership and selection runs rather than only a scalar quality column.
Proposed application: store group diagnostics and downstream evaluation deltas as versioned artifacts.

note: 工程建议由机制推导，并非论文交付的产品功能。需要可追踪 group 才能复查选数决策。

title: A bounded reproduction plan

items: Rebuild a small proxy-matched pool and compare random, GradSim, and one group method.
Fix selected tokens, training steps, model initialization, and held-out tasks across arms.
Measure generation metrics, oracle rank recovery, gradient memory, and audit cost separately.

note: 先验证选择信号是否可迁移，再投资全量梯度计算。本文阅读未执行训练，也未验证专用公开代码仓库。

title: Adoption decision

items: Published claim: group interactions explain selection failures in the tested synthetic settings.
Inference: per-record scores alone provide an incomplete selection contract.
Proposed gate: adopt a group diagnostic only after gains survive matched token and compute budgets.

note: 决策标准是训练效用与成本共同改善，不能只看离线分数相关性。来源入口及逐页讲解见 sources.md。
